SELECT T1.Maker, T4.Year 
FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 
JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker 
JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T3 ON T2.model  =  T3.model 
JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T3.MakeId  =  T4.id 
WHERE T4.year  =  (SELECT MIN(year) FROM CARS_DATA)

SELECT T1.Name ,  SUM(T2.Sales) 
FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID 
GROUP BY T1.Name 
HAVING SUM(T2.Sales)  >  300000
SELECT T1.Name ,  SUM(T2.Sales) FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name

SELECT MIN(T1.Weight) 
FROM cars_data AS T1 
JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.ModelId = T2.Model 
WHERE T2.Cylinders = 8 AND T1.Year = 1974
SELECT MAX(Accelerate) ,  Cylinders FROM CARS_DATA GROUP BY Cylinders

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM CARS_DATA 
WHERE horsepower > 150 
ORDER BY horsepower DESC 
LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(T2.MPG) FROM CARS_DATA AS T1 INNER JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.MakeId WHERE T2.Cylinders = 8 AND T1.Year BETWEEN 1974 AND 1980

SELECT AVG(mpg) 
FROM CARS_DATA 
WHERE Cylinders = 4

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker  =  T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName  =  'General Motors' OR T4.weight  <  3500

SELECT DISTINCT T1.CountryName 
FROM countries AS T1 
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.CountryId 
WHERE T2.CountryId  =  0

SELECT T1.Id, T1.Maker
FROM car_makers AS T1
JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker
JOIN car_names AS T3 ON T2.Model = T3.Model
WHERE T2.Model = 'fiat'
GROUP BY T1.Id, T1.Maker
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
SELECT name ,  capacity FROM stadium ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Abbreviation FROM AIRLINES WHERE Airline = 'JetBlue Airways'
SELECT count(*) FROM Airlines
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights
SELECT T1.FlightNo FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport   =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen"
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.FlightNo) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport   =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode JOIN airports AS T3 ON T1.SourceAirport  =  T3.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Ashley" AND T3.City  =  "Aberdeen"
SELECT COUNT(T1.Airline) FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline WHERE T2.SourceAirport  =  "AHD" AND T1.Airline = 'United Airlines'
SELECT T1.Abbreviation ,  T1.Country FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline GROUP BY T1.Abbreviation ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.Airline FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline WHERE T2.FlightNo  <  200
SELECT T1.Airline FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline WHERE T2.FlightNo  <  200

SELECT T2.name ,  T1.capacity
FROM concert AS T1
JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id
WHERE T1.year > '2013'
ORDER BY T1.capacity DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM flights AS T1 
JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode 
WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen" OR T2.City  =  "Abilene"
SELECT t2.name ,  t2.Location ,  t2.District FROM shop AS t1 JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id  =  t2.shop_id ORDER BY t2.number_products DESC

SELECT name ,  LOCATION ,  district 
FROM shop 
ORDER BY number_products DESC

SELECT T1.name 
FROM stadium AS T1 
JOIN concert AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id 
WHERE T2.year  =  '2014'

SELECT t2.name, COUNT(*) as num_employees
FROM hiring AS t1
JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id = t2.shop_id
GROUP BY t2.name
HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT MAX(num_employees) FROM (SELECT t2.name, COUNT(*) as num_employees FROM hiring AS t1 JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id = t2.shop_id GROUP BY t2.name) t3)

SELECT t1.name 
FROM employee AS t1 
JOIN evaluation AS t2 ON t1.Employee_ID  =  t2.Employee_ID 
ORDER BY t2.bonus DESC 
LIMIT 1
SELECT template_id FROM Templates EXCEPT SELECT template_id FROM Documents
SELECT DISTINCT template_type_code FROM Ref_Template_Types
SELECT T2.name ,  T1.theme ,  count(*) FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id GROUP BY T1.stadium_id

SELECT T1.paragraph_text 
FROM Paragraphs AS T1 
JOIN Documents AS T2 ON T1.document_id  =  T2.document_id 
WHERE T2.document_name  =  "Customer reviews" 
AND T1.paragraph_text LIKE '%Korea %'
SELECT Age ,  Hometown FROM teacher

SELECT T3.Name FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN course AS T2 ON T1.Course_ID  =  T2.Course_ID JOIN teacher AS T3 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T3.Teacher_ID WHERE T2.Staring_Date LIKE '%32%' OR T2.Staring_Date LIKE '%33%' LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.Name FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN teacher AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T2.Teacher_ID GROUP BY T2.Name HAVING COUNT(*)  >=  2

SELECT T1.Name 
FROM teacher AS T1 
JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T2.Teacher_ID 
WHERE T2.Grade IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.birth_date
FROM players AS T1
JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.loser_id
JOIN rankings AS T3 ON T2.match_num  =  T3.match_num
JOIN players AS T4 ON T4.player_id  =  T3.winner_id
WHERE T4.country_code  =  'USA'
ORDER BY T4.birth_date ASC

SELECT AVG(loser_age) ,  AVG(winner_age) 
FROM matches

SELECT avg(winner_rank) 
FROM matches
SELECT MIN(loser_rank) FROM matches
SELECT T1.tourney_name FROM tourney AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.tourney_id  =  T2.tourney_id GROUP BY T1.tourney_name HAVING COUNT(*)  >  10

SELECT 
  AVG(ranking) AS avg_ranking, 
  first_name 
FROM 
  players AS T1 
JOIN 
  rankings AS T2 
ON 
  T1.player_id = T2.player_id 
GROUP BY 
  first_name
SELECT country_code FROM players GROUP BY country_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.country_code, T1.birth_date
FROM players AS T1
JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.loser_id
WHERE T2.winner_rank_points  =  (SELECT MAX(winner_rank_points) FROM matches)

SELECT 
  b.name, 
  b.date, 
  b.bulgarian_commander, 
  b.result
FROM 
  battle b
WHERE 
  b.tonnage = '225'
  AND b.lost_in_battle IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT T1.address_id, T1.line_1, T1.line_2, T1.line_3, T1.city, T1.zip_postcode, T1.state_province_county, T1.country, T1.other_address_details
FROM Addresses T1
ORDER BY T1.city DESC, T1.line_3 DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM Transcripts

SELECT T3.Name 
FROM Courses AS T1 
JOIN course AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id 
JOIN teacher AS T3 ON T1.course_id  =  T3.course_id 
WHERE T2.Course  =  "Math"

SELECT DISTINCT T1.fname ,  T1.age 
FROM student AS T1 
JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid 
WHERE T2.petid IS NULL
SELECT section_name FROM Sections ORDER BY section_name DESC

SELECT DISTINCT T1.semester_name 
FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id 
WHERE T1.degree_summary_name  =  'Master' INTERSECT 
SELECT DISTINCT T1.semester_name 
FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id 
WHERE T1.degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.semester_name 
FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id 
WHERE T1.degree_summary_name  =  'Master' INTERSECT 
SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_name 
FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id 
WHERE T1.degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'

SELECT T2.transcript_date ,  T1.transcript_id
FROM Transcript_Contents AS T1
JOIN Transcripts AS T2 ON T1.transcript_id  =  T2.transcript_id
GROUP BY T1.transcript_id
ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.cell_mobile_number 
FROM Students AS T1 
JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id  =  T2.address_id 
WHERE T1.first_name  =  'timmothy' AND T1.last_name  =  'ward'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id
FROM Degree_Programs AS T1
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id
WHERE T1.degree_summary_name  =  'Master' INTERSECT
SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id
FROM Degree_Programs AS T1
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id
WHERE T1.degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'
SELECT Title FROM Cartoon ORDER BY title
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Fname FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid JOIN pets AS T3 ON T3.petid  =  T2.petid WHERE T3.pettype  =  'cat' AND T3.pettype  =  'dog'
SELECT T1.series_name FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN Cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.Title = "The Rise of the Blue Beetle!"
SELECT T2.Title FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN Cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T1.series_name = "Sky Radio"

SELECT T1.series_name, T2.Weekly_Rank 
FROM TV_Channel AS T1 
JOIN TV_series AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel 
WHERE T2.Episode = "A Love of a Lifetime"

SELECT T1.Package_Option, T1.series_name 
FROM TV_Channel AS T1 
JOIN TV_series AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel 
WHERE T2.Hight_definition_TV = 'yes' AND T2.Rating = '5.8'

SELECT T1.Package_Option 
FROM TV_Channel AS T1 
JOIN Cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel 
WHERE T2.directed_by = 'Ben Jones' 
INTERSECT 
SELECT T1.Package_Option 
FROM TV_Channel AS T1 
JOIN Cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel 
WHERE T2.directed_by = 'Michael Chang'
SELECT Final_Table_Made, Best_Finish FROM poker_player
SELECT T1.Name FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID
SELECT Final_Table_Made ,  Best_Finish FROM poker_player
SELECT Money_Rank FROM poker_player ORDER BY Earnings DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(Earnings) FROM poker_player WHERE Height > 200

SELECT DISTINCT 
  T1.state , 
  T1.created 
FROM 
  votes AS T1 
  INNER JOIN AREA_CODE_STATE AS T2 ON T1.state  =  T2.state 
  INNER JOIN CONTESTANTS AS T3 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T3.contestant_number 
WHERE 
  T3.contestant_name  =  'Tabatha Gehling'
SELECT T1.contestant_number , T1.contestant_name FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number GROUP BY T1.contestant_number HAVING count(*)  >=  2

SELECT T1.Continent 
FROM COUNTRIES AS T1 
JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode 
WHERE T2.Language  =  'English' AND T2.IsOfficial  =  'T' AND T2.Percentage  >  0.5

SELECT T1.Continent 
FROM country AS T1 
JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode 
WHERE T2.Language = 'English' AND T1.Name = 'Anguilla'

SELECT sum(population) ,  max(gnp) 
FROM country 
WHERE continent  =  "Asia"
SELECT Population FROM city WHERE District = 'Gelderland'
SELECT DISTINCT Continent FROM country
SELECT T1.Name ,  T1.Population FROM city AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" ORDER BY T1.Population DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T1.StuID FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Has_Pet AS T2 ON T1.StuID  =  T2.StuID WHERE T2.PetID IN (SELECT PetID FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'cat' AND LName = 'Smith')

SELECT DISTINCT Code 
FROM country 
WHERE Continent = 'North America' AND SurfaceArea > 3000

SELECT 
  Language , 
  CountryCode , 
  max(Percentage) 
FROM 
  countrylanguage 
GROUP BY 
  CountryCode 
ORDER BY 
  max(Percentage) DESC

SELECT 
  c.Continent, 
  SUM(c.Population) AS TotalPopulation, 
  AVG(c.LifeExpectancy) AS AverageLifeExpectancy
FROM 
  country c
  JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
  JOIN country AS T1 ON cl.CountryCode = T1.Code
WHERE 
  cl.IsOfficial = 'F'  -- 'F' means official language
GROUP BY 
  c.Continent
HAVING 
  AVG(c.LifeExpectancy)  <  72

SELECT T1.Name ,  T1.SurfaceArea 
FROM country AS T1 
JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode 
WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" OR T2.Language  =  "French" 
ORDER BY T1.SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Year_of_Work DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.Official_ratings_(millions) 
FROM performance T1 
WHERE T1.Type = 'Auditions 1' 
AND T1.Official_ratings_(millions) = (SELECT MIN(Official_ratings_(millions)) FROM performance)

SELECT T1.Name 
FROM conductor AS T1 
JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID 
GROUP BY T1.Name 
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Orchestra)  >  1
SELECT grade FROM Highschooler WHERE name  =  "Kyle"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Highschooler WHERE grade IN (9, 10)

SELECT T2.name 
FROM Friend AS T1 
JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id 
JOIN Friend AS T3 ON T1.friend_id  =  T3.id 
WHERE T2.name  =  "Kyle"
SELECT T1.student_id FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id INTERSECT SELECT T2.student_id FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.liked_id  =  T2.id
SELECT name ,  grade FROM Highschooler GROUP BY grade ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE name  =  "Kyle"
SELECT T1.ContId ,  T1.Continent ,  count(*) FROM CONTINENTS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.ContId  =  T2.Continent GROUP BY T1.ContId

SELECT T1.first_name ,  T2.name 
FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id 
WHERE T1.first_name NOT IN ( SELECT T1.first_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id WHERE T1.state  =  'Virginia' ) 
AND T1.first_name NOT IN ( SELECT T1.first_name FROM Dogs AS T2 JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id WHERE T3.date_of_treatment  >  '2020-01-01' ) 
AND T1.first_name NOT IN ( SELECT T1.first_name FROM Dogs AS T2 JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id WHERE T3.date_of_treatment  >  '2020-06-01' ) 
AND T1.first_name NOT IN ( SELECT T1.first_name FROM Dogs AS T2 JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id WHERE T3.date_of_treatment  >  '2020-09-01' ) 
AND T1.first_name NOT IN ( SELECT T1.first_name FROM Dogs AS T2 JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id WHERE T3.date

SELECT T1.role_code ,  T1.street ,  T1.city ,  T1.state 
FROM Professionals AS T1 
JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id 
WHERE T1.city LIKE '%West%'

SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.email_address 
FROM Owners AS T1 
JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id 
WHERE T1.state LIKE '%North%'

SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.email_address 
FROM Owners AS T1 
JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id 
WHERE T1.state  =  'North'

SELECT T1.cost_of_treatment
FROM Treatments T1
JOIN Charges C1 ON T1.treatment_type_code = C1.treatment_type_code
WHERE T1.date_of_treatment = (SELECT MAX(date_of_treatment) FROM Treatments)

SELECT T1.first_name ,  T2.name 
FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id 
WHERE T1.state  =  'Virginia' 
AND T2.breed_code IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T3.treatment_type_description 
FROM professionals AS T1 
JOIN treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id 
JOIN treatment_types AS T3 ON T2.treatment_type_code  =  T3.treatment_type_code
